thumbnail_mood: Joyful, safe, playful, magical, full of adventure
thumbnail_prompt_template: Create a vibrant, adorable, high-quality 3D animated YouTube thumbnail for a kids' storytelling channel called “{channel_name}”. Show cute cartoon characters with big expressive eyes, cheerful smiles, and playful outfits, surrounded by a magical fairytale storybook world matching the story scene. Use a premium Pixar-inspired 3D animation aesthetic, soft rounded character designs, bright candy colors, cinematic rim lighting, rich details, and a dreamy fairytale atmosphere. Make the characters large and clearly visible, with expressive faces that instantly grab children's attention. Use a colorful, uncluttered composition with strong contrast, soft depth of field, and a polished professional YouTube thumbnail look. Target audience: children aged 3–8 and family. The overall mood should feel joyful, safe, playful, magical, and full of adventure. No scary characters, no dark atmosphere, no photorealism, no clutter, no watermark.
